gold_verdict: Unclear, close to the band's rate; agrees with the model that risk is high
candidate_verdict: Real risk; agrees with the model

key_points.point: Verdict: unclear, own risk high ~15% vs band 18%, agrees with model; distress real but insider-backed Nov 2024 refinancing pushed debt to 2028
Cash runway: $21.1M year-end cash, ~4.7 months at average burn and ~2.7 months at Q4's $7.9M/month (roughly the filing date); January 2025 flight cancellations for maintenance
Losses are mostly cash losses: only 18% of 2024 loss non-cash; $32.3M stock-comp reversal made Q4 look profitable (+$1.3M) while Q4 underlying loss was ~$31M
Leverage: liabilities 197% of assets (2nd highest of peers), equity -$120.0M, current ratio 0.38 vs peer median 0.78
Defaults and going-concern doubt: $7.7M IRS excise tax, $1.6M property tax, $0.5M note unpaid since 2019; substantial doubt in Note 1 and PwC report
Debt maturities pushed to 2028: $44.5M Comvest loan interest-only to Nov 2028, $50M LamVen and $8M PFG notes to Dec 2028, only $2.5M due 2025, $5.5M delayed draw
Insiders keep funding: founder-linked entities lent $34.5M in 2024 and $22.5M in 2023; Comvest loan backstopped by HSBC letter of credit arranged by related party Park Lane
Limited access to equity: GEM share purchase agreement volume limits and NYSE-listing requirement while below NYSE standards
In compliance with all loan covenants at 31 Dec 2024
Revenue doubled (first full year of Southern, partly EAS subsidy); S-3 shelf filed 2025-02-11; Palantir JV deadline 31 May 2025

contradictions: Verdict: GOLD says unclear at ~15%, CANDIDATE says real risk at ~20%
Revenue peer rank: GOLD says smaller than 88% of peers, CANDIDATE gives 73rd peer percentile
NYSE cure period end: GOLD about 20 Nov 2025, CANDIDATE through about Feb 2026 (18 months from Aug 2024 plan acceptance)
Year-end cash: GOLD reports $21.1M from the 10-K, CANDIDATE says it could not check year-end cash and infers ~$21.7M
Peer count: GOLD 24 SIC-45 peers, CANDIDATE 22
extra_points_in_candidate: Property tax liens on four aircraft
PFG interest arrears of $818K charged at a 15.75% default rate
Company regained NYSE $1.00 price compliance as of Sep 30, 2024
Pending IRS offer-in-compromise on excise tax
2024 financing of $77.2M; debt rose to $122.6M from $52.1M
Unknown cash needs for 90 Cessna Caravans and post-2024 minimum cash covenant
summary: CANDIDATE matches GOLD on leverage, going-concern doubt, tax and note defaults, and the 2028 refinancing, but calls it real risk at 20% rather than unclear at 15%, and it misses GOLD's central point that the $32.3M stock-comp reversal flatters the loss and that losses are mostly cash. It also leaves out the January flight cancellations, equity-access limits and covenant compliance, and it differs from GOLD on several facts (Sep 30 cash, revenue peer rank, NYSE cure date).
